title: Reconcile audit findings across the eighteen provisional setting records
scope: Bounded corrections to already-accepted provisional records from the 2026-08-17 consistency audit: narrowing one over-broad denial, binding juvenile regrouping to autumn descent, clarifying the autumn assisting current, and aligning Markdown surfaces to their stricter structured-record wording. No new organism, place, event, or mechanic is created.
question: A two-track consistency audit of the eighteen provisional records found one over-broad denial (WLD-ECOLOGY-009 denying bed-braced locomotion that WLD-ECOLOGY-010 establishes), one seasonal impossibility (regrouping mobile young before advances when no passage season contains mobile young), one under-specified current claim (autumn current assistance), and a set of Markdown surfaces that drop or weaken qualifiers carried by their structured twins. How are these reconciled?
selection: Narrow WLD-ECOLOGY-009's denials to WLD-ECOLOGY-010's actual hedges (no general terrestrial walking, no guaranteed bed contact at every pause) so the bed-braced margin-ratchet stays established; bind WLD-ECOLOGY-010's juvenile regrouping to autumn seaward descent and record that the spring ascent is not established to include mobile young; clarify that the assisting autumn current is the outlet's ordinary year-round seaward through-flow with no peak flood required; and align the drifted Markdown surfaces to their structured twins' stricter wording, including restored qualifiers, the six-fin-fan clarification, WLD-ECOLOGY-008's tissue-reinforcement modality following WLD-ECOLOGY-007, completed dependency lines, repo-relative source-proposal paths, and the constitution's full WLD-FLORA-001 description.
alternatives: Weaken WLD-ECOLOGY-010's choreography instead of narrowing WLD-ECOLOGY-009's denial.
Make young present at spring ascent by placing hatching or development at sea.
Declare which passages include mobile young an explicit open question in both records.
Record all audit findings as known tensions without changing any accepted record.
rationale: The corrections restore agreement between jointly accepted records while preserving every deliberately open boundary. Binding regrouping to autumn descent matches WLD-ECOLOGY-006's one-warm-season rearing without constraining the still-open reproductive mode, and the through-flow clarification removes a false implication that descent needs the spring freshet.
consequences: WLD-ECOLOGY-009 no longer denies the bed-braced ratchet WLD-ECOLOGY-010 establishes; its aquatic-only boundary is preserved as general-terrestrial-walking and every-pause denials.
WLD-ECOLOGY-010's regrouping claim is bound to autumn seaward descent; the spring ascent is recorded as not established to include mobile young.
WLD-ECOLOGY-010 records that autumn current assistance is the ordinary year-round seaward through-flow.
Fourteen Markdown drift sites across the record, decision, and constitution surfaces now match their structured twins' stricter wording.
All records keep their original approving decisions; this decision governs only the reconciliation deltas.
residual_unknowns: Reproduction, birth or hatching, and early immobile stages remain open; binding regrouping to descent does not select a reproductive mode.
Seasonal outlet hydraulics, route continuity, and passage feasibility remain open under their existing gates.
Remaining audit MINOR observations on index layout, decision-template harmonization, and open-geometry seams stay unresolved by design.
reopening_conditions: A later record or chapter needs young present on the spring ascent.
Quantitative outlet hydraulics contradict the ordinary through-flow clarification.
approval_evidence: In the 2026-08-17 consistency re-evaluation, the Author was shown each conflict with resolution options and explicitly selected narrowing WLD-ECOLOGY-009, autumn regrouping, and the full cleanup batch including the through-flow clarification.
